def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + np.log2(f.operand_coalescing_aspect) * w[0]
        s = s + np.log2(f.output_store_coalescing_aspect) * w[1]
        s = s + f.tile_vector_tail_overfetch_ratio * w[2]
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[3]
    else:
        s = s + (f.cta_barrier_density * 1.0e6) * w[4]
        s = s + (f.dynamic_instruction_per_flop * 1.0e3) * w[5]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 1e-4:
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[6]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[7]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[8]
        s = s + (f.accumulator_reduction_work_ratio * 1.0e3) * w[9]
        s = s + f.reduction_iteration_padding_ratio * w[30]
        s = s + f.wave_tail_occupancy_deficit * w[31]
    else:
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[10]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[11]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[12]
        s = s + (f.accumulator_reduction_work_ratio * 1.0e3) * w[13]
        s = s + f.reduction_iteration_padding_ratio * w[32]
        s = s + f.wave_tail_occupancy_deficit * w[33]
    s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[14]
    s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure_ratio * w[15]
    s = s + f.register_file_pressure_ratio * w[16]
    s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[17]
    if p.operand_working_set_l2_ratio > 1:
        if p.shape_aspect_imbalance > 2:
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_hz_ratio) * w[18]
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_id_ratio) * w[18]
            s = s + f.a_refetch_bw_demand * w[19]
            s = s + f.b_refetch_bw_demand * w[19]
            s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[20]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_hz_ratio) * w[21]
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_id_ratio) * w[21]
            s = s + f.a_refetch_bw_demand * w[22]
            s = s + f.b_refetch_bw_demand * w[22]
            s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[23]
    else:
        if p.shape_aspect_imbalance > 2:
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_hz_ratio) * w[24]
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_id_ratio) * w[24]
            s = s + f.a_refetch_bw_demand * w[25]
            s = s + f.b_refetch_bw_demand * w[25]
            s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[26]
        else:
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_hz_ratio) * w[27]
            s = s + np.log2(f.dram_w1_id_ratio) * w[27]
            s = s + f.a_refetch_bw_demand * w[28]
            s = s + f.b_refetch_bw_demand * w[28]
            s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[29]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[0]
    s = s + f.tile_alignment_traffic_deficit * w[1]
    s = s + f.launch_tail_deficit * w[2]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[3]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[4]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.warp_output_work) * w[5]
    if p.operand_l2_pressure < 1:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[6]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.a_refetch_bw_demand + f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[7]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[8]
        s = s + np.log2(f.edge_reuse_time_ratio) * w[9]
    else:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[10]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.a_refetch_bw_demand + f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[11]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[12]
        s = s + np.log2(f.edge_reuse_time_ratio) * w[13]
    s = s + np.maximum(0.0, np.maximum(f.shared_memory_pressure, f.register_file_pressure) - 0.75) * w[14]
    s = s + np.maximum(0.0, np.maximum(f.shared_memory_pressure, f.register_file_pressure) - 0.75) * np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_k_iteration_count) * w[15]
    s = s + np.maximum(0.0, np.maximum(f.shared_memory_pressure, f.register_file_pressure) - 0.75) * f.occupancy_deficit * w[16]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_barrier_count) * w[17]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_k_iteration_count) * w[18]
    s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_k_iteration_count) * w[19]
    if p.log_flops < 30:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_fill_fraction) * w[20]
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_fill_fraction) * w[21]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_fill_fraction) * w[22]
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_fill_fraction) * w[23]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 0.01 or p.log_min_dim < 8:
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[24]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[25]
        s = s + f.splitk_reduction_work_ratio * w[26]
    else:
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[27]
        s = s + f.splitk_reduction_work_ratio * w[28]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.instruction_work_density * w[0]
    s = s + f.barrier_work_density * w[1]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[2]
        s = s + f.operand_stride_transaction_ratio * w[3]
    else:
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[4]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[5]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 0.0001:
        s = s + np.log2(f.warp_instruction_issue_count) * w[6]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[7]
        s = s + np.log2(f.edge_compute_padding_ratio) * w[8]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[9]
        s = s + f.epilogue_traffic_amortization * w[10]
        if p.log_flops > 34.0:
            s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[16]
            s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[17]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[18]
        else:
            s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[19]
            s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[20]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[21]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.warp_instruction_issue_count) * w[11]
        s = s + np.log2(f.mainloop_iteration_count) * w[12]
        s = s + np.log2(f.edge_compute_padding_ratio) * w[13]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[14]
        s = s + f.epilogue_traffic_amortization * w[15]
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[22]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[23]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[24]
    if p.l2_working_set_pressure < 1.0:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_footprint_ratio * w[25]
        s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_fraction * w[26]
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_footprint_ratio * f.cta_wave_tail_fraction * w[27]
        s = s + f.dram_w1_hz_ratio * w[28]
        s = s + f.dram_w1_id_ratio * w[29]
    else:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_footprint_ratio * w[30]
        s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_fraction * w[31]
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_footprint_ratio * f.cta_wave_tail_fraction * w[32]
        s = s + f.dram_w1_hz_ratio * w[33]
        s = s + f.dram_w1_id_ratio * w[34]
    return s
